title: [master][ALAppExtensions #30085][Event Request] Codeunit 11000007 "Check BTL91" - OnBeforeCheckFreelyTransferableMaximumAmount
summary: Codeunit 11000007 "Check BTL91" in the Dutch localization now has an OnBeforeCheckFreelyTransferableMaximumAmount event. Extensions can use it to customize the check of the freely transferable maximum amount.
key_points: Enables extensions to intercept and customize BTL91 compliance checks
Specific to Dutch banking payment processing
Affects validation logic for freely transferable maximum amounts
